experiment.research_claim: Blind discovery and low-intrusion completion of seven basic test-control capabilities in a production Go Raft library whose asynchronous runtime and real-time mechanisms differ from manually ticked protocol libraries.

system_boundary.description: Analyze the pinned github.com/hashicorp/raft module. The public Raft API and protocol state loops, Transport abstraction, InmemTransport, observer and future mechanisms, module-provided in-memory stores and snapshots, and package-provided in-process testing support are inside the boundary. Real TCP/network transport implementations and socket behavior, external durable store implementations, application FSM semantics, process supervision, and the raft-compat, fuzzy, and bench subdirectories are outside.
